{{Short description|Chinese physician and politician}}
'''Chen Hesheng''' is a Chinese [[researcher]], [[Nuclear physics|nuclear physicist]], [[Particle physics|particle physicist]], and fellow of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He was the Director of the [[Institute of High Energy Physics]] and the Vice President of the [[Chinese Physical Society]].<ref name="Institute Kong 2019">{{cite web | last1=Institute | first1=Hong Kong | last2=Kong | first2=City University of Hong | title=Hong Kong Institute for Advanced Study &#124; City University of Hong Kong | website=Hong Kong Institute for Advanced Study | date=2019-02-27 | url=https://www.ias.cityu.edu.hk/en/profile/hesheng-chen | access-date=2023-01-01}}</ref><ref name="symmetry magazine 2022">{{cite web | title=Hesheng Chen: Golden opportunities in China | website=symmetry magazine | date=2022-11-30 | url=https://www.symmetrymagazine.org/article/may-2006/commentary-hesheng-chen | access-date=2023-01-01}}</ref><ref name="Institute of Applied Physics and Materials Engineering University of Macau 2019">{{cite web | title=Prof. Hesheng CHEN, Expert in particles, gave a talk at IAPME on China Spallation Neutron Source - University of Macau | website=Institute of Applied Physics and Materials Engineering University of Macau | date=2019-10-03 | url=https://iapme.um.edu.mo/news-20191003/ | access-date=2023-01-01}}</ref>

==Education and career==

Chen obtained a degree in nuclear physics in 1970 from [[Peking University]]. He received a doctorate degree in physics from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]].<ref name="Institute of High Energy Physics"/>

In 1982, he joined the [[CERN|European Organization for Nuclear Research]] and has been working on CERN's [[L3 experiment]]. He is the head of command and engineering manager at the [[China Spallation Neutron Source]].<ref name="Institute of High Energy Physics">{{cite web | title=Chen Hesheng----Institute of High Energy Physics | website=Institute of High Energy Physics | url=http://english.ihep.cas.cn/csns/au/fae/202109/t20210910_283120.html | access-date=2023-01-01}}</ref>

He received the 2013 [[Helmholtz International Fellow Award]], and in 2005, he was elected a member of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.<ref name="Institute Kong 2019"/><ref>{{Cite web |title=Hong Kong Institute for Advanced Study {{!}} City University of Hong Kong |url=https://www.ias.cityu.edu.hk/en/profile/hesheng-chen |access-date=2023-01-01 |website=www.ias.cityu.edu.hk}}</ref>
